title: DO lane: every field of every checkpoint value the lane writes
owner: stream E lane DO (DO-P1F06); read by scripts/pm_orchestrator_event_oracles.py checkpoint_inventory_checks
model: One-event model: each read covers one retained event in one segment, which the last frame names, under one current generation node. Paths: "*" is a generation node, "{key}" its map key, "[]" an array item.

values.read.<other keys>: leaf fields, taken from the positives

rules.fields: The checker regenerates the field list from those schemas: every property at every depth whose schema is not a closed object (leaves, nullable objects, arrays and maps with their items and keys), and every other key of every positive's read. It requires every value object to be closed and every conditional branch to name only declared properties.
rules.derived: Its value follows from the event, the segment state or another field (source). Each guard names the function and refusal code that compare it with its source by exact type, and a registered single-defect negative refused with exactly that code. builder: recapture_history writes it from its source, and restores it from every repairable negative.
rules.free: Legitimately chosen data. bound is the schema's constraint; reason is what a reviewer checks; refused_forms are values the bound refuses with refused_code. guards, when present, are runtime bounds beyond the schema.
rules.freshness: The checker fails on a field with no row, a row with no field, a stale bound or an incomplete row.
